scenes.say: You think your lungs are two big balloons. They're not.
Every day, you breathe around twenty thousand times.
That's more than ten thousand liters of air. But here's where it gets weird.

visual.label: OF AIR EVERY DAY
visual.note: about half a liter per breath

scenes.say: Inside, each lung splits into smaller and smaller tubes.
They end in around four hundred and eighty million tiny air sacs.
So how big is that, spread flat?
Around seventy square meters. Thirty five times the area of your skin.
Still think they're just two balloons?
